{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
patient_id_counts = df['patient_id'].value_counts()
duplicate_patients = patient_id_counts[patient_id_counts > 1]
duplicate_count = len(duplicate_patients)
print(f'Number of duplicate patient_ids: {duplicate_count}')

# Check number of unique patients
num_unique_patients = df['patient_id'].nunique()
print(f'Number of unique patients: {num_unique_patients}')

# Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping highest sample_seq
df_sorted = df.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False)
df_dedup = df_sorted.drop_duplicates(subset='patient_id', keep='first')

# Verify deduplication
assert len(df_dedup) == num_unique_patients, 'Deduplication did not result in one row per patient'
print(f'After deduplication: {len(df_dedup)} rows')

# Check assay_batch distribution
batch_a_count = (df_dedup['assay_batch'] == 'A').sum()
batch_b_count = (df_dedup['assay_batch'] == 'B').sum()
print(f'Assay_batch A count: {batch_a_count}')
print(f'Assay_batch B count: {batch_b_count}')

# Convert batch B values from µg/L to ng/mL (divide by 10)
df_dedup['biomarker_final_ngml'] = df_dedup['biomarker_final']
df_dedup.loc[df_dedup.assay_batch == 'B', 'biomarker_final_ngml'] = df_dedup.loc[df_dedup.assay_batch == 'B', 'biomarker_final'] / 10

# Compute the mean
mean_biomarker_final = df_dedup['biomarker_final_ngml'].mean()
print(f'Mean biomarker_final (ng/mL): {mean_biomarker_final:.2f}')"}
